sessions.name: RACE: IRONMAN Calella-Barcelona
sessions.description: Target 8:50. Swim 1:08 / bike 4:38 @ ~210 W NP / run 2:59 @ 4:15/km.

rationale: Close 2026 with GREATMAN Wolsztyn 70.3 (B-race, 12 days post-Malbork DNF). Malbork was a mechanical DNF at ~45 km, not a finished IM — no transition unload. Week 1 resumes quality (anaerobic bike hole + swim volume) then eases into a mini-taper. Residual IM fitness is enough for a controlled ~4:20 70.3. Then winter base, spring 70.3-specific build into Garmin Syców (B-peak, stretch 3:59), one-week reset, then IM-specific 4h+2h bricks and a 2-week taper into Barcelona (A-goal 8:50). Syców is a real race, not a workout — mini-taper, race-power openers — but the bike is capped at ~260 W NP so the run can hold ~3:36/km and Barcelona's 2:59 is not spent in July. Swim limiter is cold/OW skill not CSS; hold >=3 swims/week.
